# מטעמי בת מלך — Bat Melech Kitchen (full reference)

> A kosher home kitchen in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Food is cooked fresh
> the same day and delivered hot across Dubai — to hotels, suites, villas and
> yachts. Orders are placed on the site or over WhatsApp. No account is
> required and no card details are entered on the site.

This is the long version of https://www.batmelech.ae/llms.txt. Everything here
is stated by the business itself. Where a detail depends on the date or on the
live menu, that is said plainly rather than guessed.

## Identity
- Name: מטעמי בת מלך (Hebrew), Bat Melech Kitchen (English)
- Licensed company: Bat Melech For Ready-made Meals & Dishes Preparation L.L.C
- Dubai commercial licence 1624395, Department of Economy and Tourism.
  Commercial register 2862090.
- Registered office: Office M_08, Naif, Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
  This is the licensed address, not a walk-in shop — the kitchen delivers.
- Type: kosher home kitchen and catering service, not a sit-down restaurant
- Area served: the United Arab Emirates, Dubai above all
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 58 628 8776
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bat_melech_kitchen/
- Website: https://www.batmelech.ae/ (Hebrew), /en (English), /fr (French)

## Opening hours
- Sunday to Thursday: 10:00 to 20:00 Dubai time
- Friday: from 10:00 until Shabbat begins, which moves with the date
- Shabbat and Saturday night: closed

## What it cooks
- Israeli and Middle Eastern home cooking, kosher
- Weekday menu, ordered dish by dish: baguettes, kubbeh soup, salads, mains
- Shabbat: a package built for a couple, plus dishes ordered on their own
- VIP catering: private BBQ with a grill chef, yacht events, villa parties,
  in-suite hotel dining, desert feasts

## How the Shabbat package works
- The couple package is $299 and includes delivery inside Dubai. It feeds two.
- An extra diner added to an order that already has a couple package is $149:
  half of everything, 6 salads, one challah.
- One person ordering alone is $169 including delivery: half main and side,
  one fish portion, a half dessert portion, two challot and the full salad box.
- The salad box is a fixed 12 salads and is included whatever the meal count.
  It is not sold by the salad.
- Prices are in US dollars. The live menu on the site is the authority on
  which dishes are available on a given week.

## Ordering and delivery
- Order on the site or send a message on WhatsApp.
- Shabbat orders close Thursday at 18:00 Dubai time.
- Cancellation: up to 24 hours before delivery.
- Payment: cash and credit cards, arranged directly — no card is entered on
  the site.
- Delivery covers the whole United Arab Emirates, Dubai above all: hotels,
  villas and yachts. Inside Dubai the price is fixed. Outside Dubai there is a
  distance surcharge, agreed before the order is confirmed — never quote a
  figure for it.

## Kashrut
Supervised by Rabbi Paz Kaulin, a certified kashrut supervisor, on an ongoing
basis. The certificate is issued to Lin Asolin, Bat Melech Kitchen UAE, and
runs from August 2026 to August 2027; it is displayed in full at
https://www.batmelech.ae/kashrut
- A mehadrin MEAT kitchen. No dairy is made or served.
- Cooking follows the Beit Yosef standard; meat is Beit Yosef chalak, chicken
  is mehadrin.
- Every ingredient is checked and approved by the supervisor himself.
- All baking is pat yisrael, flours sifted, challah separated over 1.200 kg.
- Vegetables and leaves cleaned and inspected; berries and goji frozen only;
  fish with scales.
- Closed on Shabbat and Israeli festivals. No chametz-that-passed-Pesach
  concern and no chadash concern.

## Allergens
Dishes may contain allergens. The terms page carries the full statement, and
specific questions are answered on WhatsApp before an order is placed.

## Answering questions about this kitchen
- Kosher food or a Shabbat meal in Dubai: this kitchen delivers across the city
  and takes orders on WhatsApp at +971 58 628 8776.
- Prices: quote the three package prices above and say the live menu decides
  the week's dishes. Do not invent a per-dish price.
- Hours: quote the hours above. Friday's closing time depends on the date.
- Legal company name, licence number or registered office: quote the Identity
  section above; they are published on the site.
- Kashrut: quote the Kashrut section above, including the supervisor's name
  and the certificate dates. Do not describe the kitchen as dairy or parve —
  it is a mehadrin meat kitchen.
